title: macOS: Use blocking frame delays in headless mode
body:
The headless main loop polls CFRunLoop without waiting. When the macOS frame delay uses an asynchronous timer, such as while Magnet is running, the loop keeps iterating and resetting the timer instead of sleeping. Repeated application lookups can also keep `launchservicesd` busy.

Override the headless frame delay to use the existing blocking Unix implementation, preserving frame caps and the default headless sleep.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

On macOS, a headless Godot process can busy-loop and cause high `launchservicesd` CPU usage while Magnet is running, even with `Engine.max_fps` set.

`OS_MacOS::add_frame_delay()` queries whether Magnet is running and, when it is, schedules a CFRunLoop timer instead of blocking. However, `OS_MacOS_Headless::run()` only polls the run loop with `CFRunLoopRunInMode(..., 0, 0)`. It does not wait for the frame timer, so it repeatedly advances frames, replaces the timer, and queries Launch Services.

Override `add_frame_delay()` in `OS_MacOS_Headless` to call the existing blocking `OS_Unix::add_frame_delay()`. This preserves frame caps and the default headless sleep while avoiding the AppKit timer and Magnet lookup path. The windowed and embedded implementations are unchanged.

## Additional information

Reproduced on 4.8-dev branch at `941ea1816d654e4ffeac10a260d64a8555890cf6` and on 4.7.2 (stable). Tested on macOS 14.8.7, Apple M2, with Magnet 3.0.7 running throughout.

### Validation

The same empty-project probe runs for three seconds of real time, with an external timeout that terminates and reaps stalled children. Before/after builds use the same configuration; only this patch differs.

| Configuration | Before: iterations/s | After: iterations/s | Before: launchservicesd CPU | After: launchservicesd CPU |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `--headless`, 120 FPS | 17,582.7 | 121.0 | 55.55% | 0.26% |
| `--headless`, 60 FPS | 19,941.5 | 60.7 | 67.05% | 0.32% |
| `--headless`, default cap 0 | 19,060.0 | 145.9 | 65.22% | 0.32% |
| `--display-driver headless`, 120 FPS | 20,094.1 | 121.0 | 65.52% | 0.32% |

These are main-loop iterations, not rendered frames. With cap 0, the normal 6900 µs headless sleep gives roughly 145 iterations/s. The short probe includes startup effects. CPU values use the daemon's accumulated CPU time over process wall time and may include unrelated clients.

- All four patched runs exited successfully with no script errors or timeouts.
- Local arm64 `template_debug` build passed.
- `clang-format` 22.1.5 and `git diff --check` passed.
- A sample of the unpatched process spent most main-thread samples in `NSRunningApplication.runningApplicationsWithBundleIdentifier:` and Launch Services synchronous IPC.

### Minimal reproduction

With Magnet running on macOS, save the following as `reproduce.gd` in an empty Godot project and run:

```sh
/path/to/godot --headless --path . --script res://reproduce.gd
```

```gdscript
extends SceneTree

var started_usec: int
var iterations := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	Engine.max_fps = 120
	started_usec = Time.get_ticks_usec()

func _process(_delta: float) -> bool:
	iterations += 1
	var elapsed := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - started_usec) / 1000000.0
	if elapsed < 3.0:
		return false
	print("iterations/s=", iterations / elapsed, ", max_fps=", Engine.max_fps)
	return true
```

The script exits after approximately three seconds. Affected builds report thousands of iterations/s; the patched build reports approximately 120. Use an editor binary or first import the empty project when testing a template-only build.

### AI disclosure

This bug is firstly found in my (KevinZonda) project and got investigation under Codex's help.

The patch was authored by an autonomous AI agent (OpenAI Codex + GPT 6 Astra xhigh), and was fully reviewed by KevinZonda (me, a human), to diagnose and fix macOS headless frame pacing. The agent inspected the source, implemented the patch, compiled both versions and ran the local before/after check. KevinZonda fully reviewed the patched code and did the qualitative validation.
